reply:
CMD is overridable at runtime. `docker run image sh` replaces the CMD without needing a new image.

ENTRYPOINT is the one requiring `--entrypoint` to override.

So to your original question: No, you don't need a new image. Run `docker run container_image sh` and it will drop you into a shell instead of running `node server.js`.
